name: Skills Router Meta-Skill
description: Deterministic skills router for AI coding agents: route tasks, manage dormant skills, and run the 4-phase execution pipeline.

mcp_tools.name: list_skills
mcp_tools.description: Discover project skills from YAML frontmatter without reading full bodies.

mcp_tools.name: read_skill
mcp_tools.description: Read the full SKILL.md body of a routed skill (progressive disclosure on demand).

mcp_tools.name: route
mcp_tools.description: Route a task query to the optimal skill(s) via the deterministic router (runs on host via shell).

mcp_tools.name: dormancy_check
mcp_tools.description: Check dormant/active status of all skills in .agents/skills/ or ./skills/.
